$comment: Deterministic budgets, enforced in CI (tools/perf/check-budgets.mjs; requests by tests/e2e/kiosk-budget.spec.ts). CPU, memory and frame counts are report-only. The entry budgets are CI's (Linux) measured bytes; entryGzipSlack (0.1 %) is added on top because the same build gzips a few bytes apart per platform and runner image. Lower a budget when a change shrinks the number; raise one only with a reason in the commit.

packs.$comment: Per built-in pack (src/looks/packs/<id>.ts, its Look id): codeGzipBytes = its lazy JS and CSS chunks (found through the Vite manifest), gzip; assetBytes = the files in src/looks/packs/<id>/assets, bytes on disk; layersPerPage = the layer reasons counted on the heavy kiosk screen with the pack on (tests/e2e/pack-visibility.spec.ts counts them; check-budgets does not). Set to the measured size plus 25 %, never above packCeilingBytes (code gzip plus assets), lowered whenever a pack shrinks. A pack with no entry here fails the check (node tools/perf/check-budgets.mjs --packs). Measured at P10 round 1: field-kit 11, tape-86 11, term 10 (Classic 9); at P11a: neon-stripe 10, overdrive 9, swiss-mono 10, holo 11: the budget is that plus 25 %. The count is the CSS reasons for a layer, not the compositor's own.
